Establish overall materiality, performance materiality and the clearly-trivial threshold, with documented rationale.

# WP-BNK-01: Bank reconciliation testing

*Area: Cash and bank | Illustrative template — not firm-approved | 2026-10-23*

## 1. Objective

Verify that the year-end bank reconciliation is mathematically accurate, supported, and that reconciling items are valid.

R-CSH-001: errors and irregularities in bank transactions remain undetected.

- BAL-EXI (existence)
- BAL-COM (completeness)

All material bank reconciliations at the reporting date, including dormant accounts.

1. Agree cash-book and bank-statement balances; reperform the reconciliation arithmetic.

100% of material reconciliations reperformed; all long-outstanding items investigated (no sampling for stale items).

Management override of controls; fraudulent journals (ISA 240 presumed risk).

- (all — override can affect any assertion)

Full journal population for the period, filtered by risk criteria; all entries posted on non-business days, by senior management, with round numbers, or to unusual accounts.

Risk-targeted selection, not random sampling — every high-risk entry is examined. Document the filters and why they address override risk.
